title: Last dev b6cd1e1 no connect danaRS
body:
After install last dev [b6cd1e1] on my samsung s25ultra android 15 my danaRS not connect.

I reset the connection and tried switching to virtual pump, but the situation does not resolve. The pump shows the connection in progress but AAps remains constantly search.

I've always used dev and never master. Switching to the June 2025 dev version everything restarted normally, but aaps completely reset.
